g.style: fill:#000000; fill-opacity:1.0000;stroke:#000000; stroke-opacity:1.0000; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;

g.text: Title: Big Modular - quiet bipolar post-regulators

g.desc: Title: Big Modular - quiet bipolar post-regulators

g.style: fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;
fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;

g.text: Raw +13.530611/-13.920585V remain internal. Final +5V is unchanged and bypasses this sheet.

g.desc: Raw +13.530611/-13.920585V remain internal. Final +5V is unchanged and bypasses this sheet.

g.text: Both exposed pads 21 are GND. Exact requested RGWR parts; NOT a +/-1A supply.

g.desc: Both exposed pads 21 are GND. Exact requested RGWR parts; NOT a +/-1A supply.

g.text: U12 ANY-OUT: 5,6,9,11 to GND; 4,8,10,12 float. SENSE3 -> final output.

g.desc: U12 ANY-OUT: 5,6,9,11 to GND; 4,8,10,12 float. SENSE3 -> final output.

g.text: C60 sees approximately +12V. 4/6/4/3 x22u on IN+/OUT+/IN-/OUT-; typical bias + tolerance/temp/aging screen passes.

g.desc: C60 sees approximately +12V. 4/6/4/3 x22u on IN+/OUT+/IN-/OUT-; typical bias + tolerance/temp/aging screen passes.

g.text: Require >=10u effective at each IN/OUT; >=20u at positive OUT for accuracy conditions.

g.desc: Require >=10u effective at each IN/OUT; >=20u at positive OUT for accuracy conditions.

g.text: R72+R73 / R74 = 92.11k / 10k -> -11.997925V before IFB; 117.5uA nominal divider current (>5uA required).

g.desc: R72+R73 / R74 = 92.11k / 10k -> -11.997925V before IFB; 117.5uA nominal divider current (>5uA required).

g.text: C61 100n: typical ~120ms start, not rail sequencing. C62 10n improves AC; shutdown FB kick remains a test gate.

g.desc: C61 100n: typical ~120ms start, not rail sequencing. C62 10n improves AC; shutdown FB kick remains a test gate.

g.text: D27/D28 divert reverse current, do NOT block it. SS34 Vf does NOT prove the negative -0.3V differential limit.

g.desc: D27/D28 divert reverse current, do NOT block it. SS34 Vf does NOT prove the negative -0.3V differential limit.

g.text: 800mA aspiration is load-dependent, not a simultaneous rail guarantee. Capacitor bias/ESR, transient and board thermal qualification pending.

g.desc: 800mA aspiration is load-dependent, not a simultaneous rail guarantee. Capacitor bias/ESR, transient and board thermal qualification pending.

g.text: Raw-divider and LDO-divider Extended resistor candidates require an explicit Basic-policy exception before assembly.

g.desc: Raw-divider and LDO-divider Extended resistor candidates require an explicit Basic-policy exception before assembly.
